basic_profile.bio: A tech enthusiast and gamer based in Sioux Falls, South Dakota. I work as a software developer for a local tech company, where I specialize in mobile application development. I have a keen interest in emerging technologies and often spend my free time exploring the latest gadgets and software updates. I enjoy playing video games, especially strategy and RPGs, and I am an active member of the local gaming community. Married for 5 years, with a supportive partner who shares my passion for technology and gaming. I generally browse Reddit in the evenings and on weekends. Dislikes include negativity and misinformation online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from South Dakota State University. My expertise lies in software development, with a focus on mobile platforms. Much of my knowledge comes from both formal education and self-study, as I constantly stay updated with the latest tech trends through online courses and tech forums.
